本頁由 `scripts/generate_knowledge_reference.py` 產生；請修改正式來源後重建。

本索引列出九個公開 facade 的宣告名稱；名稱清單不取代各 API 的參數與行為契約。

## 宣告的公開匯出

### scgsim.aedt

`AedtResources`, `AedtSpec`, `EigenmodeRunControl`, `EigenmodeSim`, `EprAnalysisRequest`, `EprResult`, `ExpressionCacheConvergence`, `ExpressionCacheConvergenceSet`, `FrequencySweepSpec`, `HandoffPlan`, `HfssDrivenGeometrySpec`, `HfssEprAnalysisSpec`, `HfssEprSpec`, `HfssRunControl`, `HfssSpec`, `LumpedRlc`, `LumpedTerminalPort`, `MatrixRunControl`, `ModalPort`, `NativeBatchPackage`, `NativeExpressionDefinition`, `NormalizedSurfaceEprTotal`, `PdkMaterial`, `PlanarJunction`, `PreparedModel`, `PreparedSgbModel`, `Q2dConductorSpec`, `Q2dRectangleSpec`, `Q2dSpec`, `Q3dNetSpec`, `Q3dSpec`, `ResolvedRun`, `SavedSolution`, `SimulationDrcReport`, `StageResult`, `TerminalPort`, `analyze_epr`, `collect_native_batch`, `parse_aedt_spec`, `planar_junction_from_port`, `plot_epr_result`, `prepare_handoff`, `prepare_hfss_driven_from_geometry`, `prepare_hfss_eigenmode_from_geometry`, `prepare_native_batch`, `prepare_q3d_from_geometry`, `prepare_sgb_model`, `reanalyze_epr`, `request_q3d_abort_and_save`, `request_q3d_stop_and_save`, `resolve_epr_result`, `resolve_prepared_model`, `resolve_results`, `resolve_saved_solution`, `run_native_batch`, `show_epr`.

### scgsim.aedt.specs

`HfssDrivenGeometrySpec`, `LumpedRlc`, `LumpedTerminalPort`, `TerminalPort`.

### scgsim.geometry

`ApproximationProfile`, `BoundaryCurveChainSpec`, `Coordinate`, `CurveKindLiteral`, `CurveOrientationLiteral`, `GdsBoundaryReconstructionSpec`, `GeometryBuildInput`, `GeometryPlan`, `GeometryPlanSnapshot`, `InputSummary`, `JunctionTerminalBinding`, `LayoutPolygonSpec`, `PathInput`, `PhysicalLayerDeclaration`, `PhysicalRepresentationPlan`, `PolygonRing`, `PortSheetOverlapRecord`, `PortSheetRegionRecord`, `RectangularJunctionSpec`, `RouteLiteral`, `SemanticEntitySpec`, `SourceCurveSpec`, `VacuumRegionSpec`, `Vector3D`, `apply_vacuum_region_to_stack`, `build_gds_stack_geometry_input`, `interpret_physical_geometry`, `interpret_physical_layers`, `summarize_geometry_input`, `with_rectangular_junctions`.

### scgsim.palace

`Capacitance`, `ConvergenceCheck`, `ConvergencePlan`, `ConvergenceVerdict`, `Criterion`, `CriterionGroup`, `EigenmodeSim`, `ElectrostaticSim`, `ErrorIndicator`, `ModeFrequency`, `PalaceCost`, `PalaceEprResult`, `PalaceFailureDiagnosis`, `PalacePerformance`, `PalaceProvenance`, `PalaceResultSelection`, `PalaceReturnedReceipt`, `PalaceTrustReport`, `ParsedTable`, `PassCostRecord`, `PhysicsQuantitiesReport`, `ResolvedPalaceResult`, `SimulationBenchmarkReport`, `SimulationDrcError`, `SimulationDrcReport`, `SolverEnd`, `StageResult`, `SurfaceEpr`, `SurfaceMarginEprRecord`, `SurfaceMarginEprSeriesSnapshot`, `epr_result`, `inspect_run_trustworthiness`, `reanalyze_epr`, `resolve_epr_result`, `resolve_palace_result`, `show_epr`.

### scgsim.semantics

`SemanticFactsSnapshot`, `SemanticSnapshotReference`, `canonical_sha256`, `create_snapshot`.

### scgsim.visualization

`GeometryPreview`, `GeometryPreviewArtifact`, `inspect_aedt_geometry`, `inspect_palace_geometry`.
